title:
Allows the construction and execution of queries for {@link ReliabilityMetric}s.

Usage example:
```
ReliabilityMetricTimedDataQuery.make({
  reliabilityMetric: ['metric1', 'metric2']
}).execute({start: '2020-01-01', end: '2021-01-01', interval: 'QUARTER_HOUR'})
```
name: ReliabilityMetricTimedDataQuery
